result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position: CGL is $1M per occurrence/$2M aggregate, E&O is $2M, cyber is $5M for a vendor processing customer or user data, workers’ compensation is statutory, and certificates are available on request. However, requiring all coverage to continue for one year after termination is not in the playbook and imposes an unnecessary additional obligation. The cyber coverage description is also broader than necessary because it extends to all Confidential Information and Content rather than only Customer Data. The original headings/counterparts provision remains unchanged, and the drafting is otherwise professional.
